# Retana Transfers Tamarindo

> Shared shuttles and private transfers in Guanacaste, Costa Rica, since 2015.
> Scheduled shared departures from Tamarindo to Liberia Airport (LIR) and other
> destinations; a shared departure opens once three passengers are confirmed.
> Shared seats from $30 per person; private transfers priced per vehicle and
> available any time. Online booking with confirmation by email and WhatsApp.

Formerly Retana Services Tamarindo.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://retanatransfers.com/): service overview, live routes and online booking
- [Routes](https://retanatransfers.com/routes): all active shuttle routes with prices and schedules
- [Book](https://retanatransfers.com/book): search departures and reserve seats

## Pricing

All prices shown in USD. Shared shuttles are priced per person; private transfers per vehicle.

| Route | Shared (per person) | Private (per vehicle) |
|---|---|---|
| Liberia Airport (LIR) ↔ Tamarindo | $30 | $120 |
| Tamarindo ↔ Nosara | $35 | $140 |
| Tamarindo ↔ Monteverde | $45 | $180 |
| Tamarindo ↔ Arenal / La Fortuna | $55 | $220 |
| Tamarindo ↔ San José / SJO Airport | $65 | $260 |

Private transfer pricing: base price covers up to 4 passengers. Groups of 5 or more pay a one-time supplement of $20 (not per person). Payment is accepted via PayPal online at the time of booking.

## Schedules

Service hours: 06:00–22:00 daily. Shared shuttle departure times per route:

- **Liberia Airport ↔ Tamarindo**: departure times vary — check live availability at retanatransfers.com/routes
- **Tamarindo to Arenal / La Fortuna**: 7:00 AM, 9:00 AM
- **Tamarindo to Monteverde**: 7:00 AM, 10:00 AM
- **Tamarindo to San José / SJO**: 6:00 AM, 8:00 AM
- **Tamarindo to Nosara**: 9:00 AM, 2:00 PM

Private transfers depart at any time the customer chooses, 06:00–22:00.

## Policies

**Shared departures**: A shared departure opens once three passengers are confirmed. From then on anyone can join it, even travelling alone, and booking three seats starts a departure on a day when none is running. Private transfers have no minimum and run at any time.

**Booking**: Seats are held while payment is completed. Booking is confirmed once payment is received. Recommend booking at least 24 hours in advance; earlier in high season (December–April).

**Cancellation**: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure (full refund, minus any payment processing fees). Cancellations less than 48 hours before departure are non-refundable. No-shows are non-refundable.

**Flight delays**: For airport arrivals, the driver tracks the flight in real time and waits up to 1 hour after landing at no extra charge. For departures to LIR, the maximum wait time at pickup is 15 minutes.

**Baggage**: Each passenger may bring 1 carry-on item and 2 checked bags at no extra charge. Surfboards and oversized items must be declared at booking.

**Infants**: Infants occupy a seat and must be booked as passengers.

**Service area**: Door-to-door pickups and drop-offs in Tamarindo, Playa Langosta, Playa Grande, Playa Avellanas, and surrounding Guanacaste areas.
